title: Fritz-Walter-Stadion - Wikipedia
content: * 2 2006 FIFA World Cup. Football stadium in Kaiserslautern, Germany. **Fritz-Walter-Stadion** (German pronunciation:  ⓘ) is the home stadium of 1. FC Kaiserslautern and is located in the city of Kaiserslautern, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany. It was one of the stadia used in the 2006 FIFA World Cup. It is named after Fritz Walter (1920–2002), who played for the Kaiserslautern club throughout his career and was captain of the Germany national football team that won the 1954 FIFA World Cup in the "Miracle of Bern". ## 2006 FIFA World Cup. The stadium was one of the venues for the 2006 FIFA World Cup. The following games were played at the stadium:. FCK logo, the logo of the 2006 FIFA World Cup, and the Betzenberg Devil on the side of the north stand.
